errors.evidence: The description omits the '1e-6' multiplier for the y-axis values, which is explicitly shown at the top of the y-axis. This changes the scale of the learning rate values by a factor of one million.
The plot shows the line decreasing to approximately 0 at the end of the training steps (around 1300), not 0.2.
The phrase 'notable decline' is a subjective interpretation of the trend. A more objective description would describe the shape of the curve.
